A single astronaut wearing a white spacesuit with a gold reflective visor floats inside a space station, shown from the waist up in a wide frame with open space around the body. Both arms and both white gloves are fully visible within the frame. A large round window behind the astronaut shows the blue Earth against black space. Pale wall panels and fixed handrails frame the window. The suit has blue fabric patches and dark joints at the elbows. The astronaut floats upright with both hands resting close to the chest. The suit hoses drift gently. Medium wide shot, static camera, soft artificial light from the station ceiling.

A single adult red fox with thick orange fur, a white chest, dark ears and a bushy white-tipped tail sits close to the camera on white snow and fills most of the frame. Behind the fox stands a small wooden cabin with a snowy roof and one lit window. Dark pine trees rise behind the cabin. The whole head, chest, front paws and curled tail are clearly visible. The fox slowly turns its head toward the camera. Small clouds of breath rise from its muzzle. Medium close-up shot, static camera, day time, soft daylight.
